import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int MAXE = 400005;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int SOURCE = 501;
    static final int SINK = 502;

    static char[][] firstGrid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] secondGrid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distSafe = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][] distBetween = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
    static Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
    static int[] dirX = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static int[] u = new int[MAXE+1];
    static int[] v = new int[MAXE+1];
    static int[] fl = new int[MAXE+1];
    static int[] c = new int[MAXE+1];
    static int[] nxt = new int[MAXE+1];
    static int[] head = new int[505];
    static int[] parentEdge = new int[505];
    static int edgeCnt = 0;
    static int answer = 0;

    static void addEdge(int uu, int vv, int cap) {
        edgeCnt++;
        u[edgeCnt] = uu;
        v[edgeCnt] = vv;
        fl[edgeCnt] = 0;
        c[edgeCnt] = cap;
        nxt[edgeCnt] = head[uu];
        head[uu] = edgeCnt;
        edgeCnt++;
        int index = edgeCnt;
        // second edge
        // Note: u[edgeCnt] is already set for first, then second edge now
        // We need to call addEdge as two edges: forward and backward.
        // But in C++ they used a single addEdge that adds both. We'll implement accordingly.
        // However, this method adds forward, we'll call again with reverse inside.
    }

    // Better: implement inline methods similar to original.
    // Redefine addEdge properly.
    // Let's rewrite:
    static void addEdge2(int uu, int vv, int cap) {
        // forward edge
        edgeCnt++;
        u[edgeCnt] = uu;
        v[edgeCnt] = vv;
        fl[edgeCnt] = 0;
        c[edgeCnt] = cap;
        nxt[edgeCnt] = head[uu];
        head[uu] = edgeCnt;

        // backward edge
        edgeCnt++;
        u[edgeCnt] = vv;
        v[edgeCnt] = uu;
        fl[edgeCnt] = 0;
        c[edgeCnt] = 0;
        nxt[edgeCnt] = head[vv];
        head[vv] = edgeCnt;
    }

    static boolean findPath() {
        Queue<Integer> qu = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Arrays.fill(used, 0);
        Arrays.fill(depth, 0);
        qu.offer(SOURCE);
        used[SOURCE] = 1;
        depth[SOURCE] = 1;
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qu.poll();
            for (int i = head[x]; i > 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                int y = v[i];
                if (used[y] == 0 && fl[y] < c[y]) {
                    parentEdge[y] = i;
                    used[y] = 1;
                    depth[y] = depth[x] + 1;
                    qu.offer(y);
                    if (y == SINK) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int x, int now) {
        if (x == SINK || now == 0) return now;
        int remain = now;
        for (int i = head[x]; i > 0; i = nxt[i]) {
            int y = v[i];
            if (c[i] > fl[i] && depth[y] == depth[x] + 1) {
                int pushed = sendFlow(y, Math.min(remain, c[i] - fl[i]));
                if (pushed == 0) depth[y] = 0;
                fl[i] += pushed;
                // find reverse edge
                int rev = (i % 2 == 1) ? i + 1 : i - 1;
                fl[rev] -= pushed;
                remain -= pushed;
                if (remain == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return now - remain;
    }

    static void runDinic() {
        while (findPath()) {
            answer += sendFlow(SOURCE, INF);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int limit = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                firstGrid[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                distSafe[i][j] = 10000;
                if (firstGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    distSafe[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (firstGrid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int cap = firstGrid[i][j] - '0';
                    addEdge2(SOURCE, (i - 1) * n + j, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for safe distances
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && firstGrid[nx][ny] <= '9' && distSafe[nx][ny] > distSafe[x][y] + 1) {
                    distSafe[nx][ny] = distSafe[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        // Build edges between first grid cells
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (firstGrid[i][j] > '9') continue;
                // Initialize distances from (i,j)
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        distBetween[i][j][k][l] = 10000;
                    }
                }
                q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                distBetween[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q.poll();
                    int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                        if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && firstGrid[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                            distBetween[i][j][nx][ny] > distBetween[i][j][x][y] + 1 &&
                            distBetween[i][j][x][y] < distSafe[x][y]) {
                            distBetween[i][j][nx][ny] = distBetween[i][j][x][y] + 1;
                            q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Add edges from this cell to target cells
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        int dist = distBetween[i][j][k][l];
                        if (dist <= Math.min(distSafe[k][l], limit)) {
                            addEdge2((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Read second grid and add edges to sink
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                secondGrid[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (secondGrid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int cap = secondGrid[i][j] - '0';
                    addEdge2((i - 1) * n + j + 100, SINK, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        runDinic();
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
